authority_basis.summary: Operator assigned the flavor admission program to marici.Figueiredo with proceed-at-will authority; recording the WP8 test outcome completes the WP8 graph record.

evidence.paraphrase: 61 minima from 14 orbits at one physical point (best chi2 3.3628) realize 18 distinct folded loop-phase values with within-group spread <= 2.3e-8 rad against a minimum between-group gap of 2.9e-5 rad; 4 charts each carry two discrete solutions at the same physics (flagship chart (11,(298,412),(d,1,1)): phi 0.817882 vs 0.819271, observables agree to 1.1e-7 sigma, log-magnitude L2 distance 9.66); WP4-motivated cores match beta, gamma, alpha and pi-2gamma to <= 1.2 mrad; the 0.818 cluster matches no motivated core (>= 22 mrad).

operations.outcome: Supports: the loop-phase fiber at fixed physics is exactly discrete and multi-valued even within single charts; cluster cores are UT angles plus chart-level cores whose LO identification is open.
